children: Slovenia's seasonally adjusted manufacturing confidence indicator rose to -2 in September 2026 from -4 in August, matching July's reading, which was the least pessimistic since August 2022, but remaining slightly below its long-term average of -1.9.
Production expectations strengthened to 12 from 6 in August, while selling price expectations rose to 8 from 6.
On the other hand, the uncertainty gauge increased to 32 from 27.
Meanwhile, stocks of finished products and production both held steady at 5.
The deterioration in export order books eased to -14 from -16, while overall order books improved to -12 from -14.
Moreover, expected employment was unchanged at 9, while the labour hoarding indicator fell to 5 from 7.
Outside manufacturing, confidence weakened in retail trade and services, while remaining unchanged in construction.

title: Slovenia Business Mood Improves in September
